deck: Set 1: Plan & Govern AI Business Solutions
term: CFO Quarterly Custom AI Agent Review (Model Selection & Orchestration)
definition:
When a CFO evaluates custom AI agent designs in a quarterly financial/ROI analysis, the two primary architectural cost components are:
• **GPT Models Used for the Agent**: Reasoning/flagship models (`gpt-4o`, `o1`) vs. mini models (`gpt-4o-mini`), and PTU vs. pay-as-you-go token pricing.
• **Agent Orchestration Method**: Autonomous/Generative orchestration triggers multi-step reasoning turns and subagent tool invocations, multiplying message/token consumption compared to classic deterministic routing.
examTip: Eliminate user-telemetry metrics like 'average characters in a chat message' or 'average session time per agent' when asked about **custom AI agent design components** for financial analysis.

deck: Set 1: Plan & Govern AI Business Solutions
term: Microsoft Purview vs. Defender vs. Azure Policy for Foundry Agents
definition:
• **Microsoft Purview**: Governs **data residency**, cross-region data movement compliance (e.g., US and Europe), sensitivity labels, DLP, and grounding data compliance for Microsoft Foundry agents.
• **Microsoft Defender for Cloud**: Runtime AI threat protection, Prompt Shields, and security posture management.
• **Azure Policy**: Resource deployment guardrails (allowed SKUs/regions at ARM level, not grounding data movement governance).
examTip: Whenever an exam scenario mentions **data residency and movement regulations** for agents and their **grounding data**, select **Microsoft Purview**.

deck: Set 1: Plan & Govern AI Business Solutions
term: Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) vs. Power Platform Adoption
definition:
• **Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework for Azure (CAF)**: Enterprise framework for infrastructure migration, landing zones, cloud governance, and AI workload readiness.
• **Power Platform / Copilot Studio Adoption Framework**: Center of Excellence (CoE) starter kit, environment strategy, and citizen-developer governance.
examTip: In the Fabrikam case study, use **Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework for Azure** for the **infrastructure migration** requirement.

deck: Set 1: Plan & Govern AI Business Solutions
term: Microsoft Entra Privileged Identity Management (PIM) & Agent ID
definition:
• **Microsoft Entra PIM**: Provides **time-bound, just-in-time (JIT) role activation** with approval workflows and audit trails for privileged administrators.
• **App Registrations & Entra Agent ID**: Enables third-party cloud services and autonomous AI agents to authenticate securely to Microsoft Entra with scoped permissions.
examTip: Entra PIM = **time-bound role activation**. Conditional Access = **control over how users/agents access cloud apps**.

deck: Set 2: Microsoft Copilot Studio & Agent Architecture
term: Copilot Studio Templates (Voice vs. IT Helpdesk vs. Citizen Services)
definition:
• **Voice Template in Microsoft Copilot Studio**: Built-in DTMF, speech recognition, barge-in handling, and telephony handoff for hands-free field/sales executives and contact center callers.
• **Fallback Topic**: Triggered automatically when an AI agent encounters unexpected user input or unrecognized actions that match no defined topic or knowledge source.
examTip: In the Fabrikam case study, select **Voice in Microsoft Copilot Studio** for mobile/hands-free sales executives, and **a fallback topic** for handling unexpected AI agent actions.

deck: Set 2: Microsoft Copilot Studio & Agent Architecture
term: Extending Microsoft 365 Copilot to Azure Logic & External Systems
definition:
• **Copilot Studio Actions / API Plugins / Custom Connectors**: Allow Microsoft 365 Copilot to invoke external business logic hosted in Azure services (Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, Azure API Management, or Microsoft Foundry endpoints).
• **Graph Connectors (Copilot Connectors)**: Ingest external unstructured content into the Microsoft Graph index for grounding.
examTip: Use **Copilot Connectors (Graph Connectors)** for read-only knowledge indexing; use **Copilot Studio Actions / Custom Connectors / API Plugins** to invoke external logic in Azure.

term: Dataverse Non-Standard Terminology & Custom Lead Columns
definition: When a company stores records in a Microsoft Dataverse table (such as `Lead` in Dynamics 365 Sales) using non-standard terminology and custom column names, configure **synonyms, column descriptions, and glossary terms** in Copilot Studio / Dataverse knowledge settings so the AI agent accurately maps natural language queries to custom schema fields.
examTip: Adding **synonyms and descriptions** to Dataverse table columns resolves natural-language-to-SQL/Dataverse mismatches without renaming underlying database columns.

term: Dynamics 365 Sales Copilot Email Assist & Finance In-App Guidance
definition:
• **Copilot Email Assist (Dynamics 365 Sales)**: Generates contextual prospect communication emails using CRM lead/opportunity data.
• **Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Copilot In-App Help**: Uses Business Process Catalog / Task Recorder guides and organizational documentation to answer user workflow questions directly inside the app.
examTip: For prospect communication requirements in Dynamics 365 Sales, select **Copilot email assist**.
